recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not reinterpret FHIR-14443 as requiring Observation.subject Reference(Any); current source reflects the accepted focus-based model.
issue_request: FHIR-14443 was Published/Persuasive with Modification and argued Observation.subject was too narrow for observations about other observations, practitioners, organizations, and other entities. The accepted resolution was the same focal-subject/focus approach rather than making Observation.subject Reference(Any).
initial_application: Commit 5c093b94a97c0320ee01c1ec9914fd824433ba4e explicitly mentions GF#14443 while renaming Observation.focalSubject to Observation.focus; the surrounding d06b52856c89401a981241a811faa7b455037c08 work added the focal-subject and boundary text changes.
additional_context: The Zulip thread records the choice to keep a clear subject/record target, add an inline focus element, and discourage use of Observation when a more specific resource exists. FHIR-15825 later changed focus cardinality to 0..*.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current Observation.subject definition points to focus/code when the actual focus differs from subject, Observation.focus is present as 0..* Reference(Resource), and current narrative explains subject, focus, and device usage.
